## Outcome

Build the modular Python parser/indexer described in
[EPIC_01_REPO_HISTORY_EXAMPLE.md](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/blob/main/repo-history/EPIC_01_REPO_HISTORY_EXAMPLE.md), under `repo-history/`.
Use GestaltDB for temporal entities and relationships, GitHub as the first remote
provider, and LangChain chat-model interfaces for working first-release LLM
enrichment. This issue tracks implementation, not just the planning document.

## Bounded demonstrator

- Repository: [`mylonasc/tf_gnns`](https://github.com/mylonasc/tf_gnns).
- Window: `[2026-09-13T00:00:00Z, 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z)`.
- Pinned anchor: `9bfe6c19c02723dbbf101b9e311de684a4728bb1`.
- Expected scope: 16 commits and PRs
  [#10](https://github.com/mylonasc/tf_gnns/pull/10),
  [#11](https://github.com/mylonasc/tf_gnns/pull/11), and
  [#12](https://github.com/mylonasc/tf_gnns/pull/12), with necessary baseline trees.
- This slice has no discovered standalone issues, provider labels, or issue
  hierarchy. Cover those with clearly synthetic offline fixtures; do not invent
  live history. Current branch/API observations must not be backdated.

## Cross-cutting requirements

- Use Python libraries, not subprocess/CLI wrappers, in the framework.
- Preserve immutable evidence, temporal coverage, provenance, and exact source links.
- Run issue analysis in a separate OS process and publish through a single writer.
- Keep historical context isolated from future documents, labels, and vocabulary.
- Ship deterministic/offline operation and an explicitly enabled real LangChain path.
- Enforce request/content/token budgets, caching, safe retries, and resumability.
- Treat repository text as untrusted; do not execute it or mutate remote work items.

## Implementation slices

Native GitHub sub-issues and the checklist below track the same RH-indexed work.
Each child has acceptance criteria, dependency links, and inspection labels.

- [ ] [RH-03: Documentation and code-content extraction](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/10)
- [ ] [RH-04: GitHub work items, PRs, labels, and hierarchy](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/11)
- [ ] [RH-05: Temporal replay and resumable orchestration](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/12)
- [ ] [RH-06: GestaltDB temporal graph persistence](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/13)
- [ ] [RH-07: Topic registry and deterministic/NLP labeling](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/14)
- [ ] [RH-08: LangChain structured LLM enrichment](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/15)
- [ ] [RH-09: Separate issue-analysis worker process](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/16)
- [ ] [RH-10: Evidence-backed cross-entity linking](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/17)
- [ ] [RH-11: Inspection queries and graph visualization](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/18)
- [ ] [RH-12: Reproducible demonstrator and release evaluation](https://github.com/mylonasc/gestaltdb-examples/issues/19)

## Release acceptance

- [ ] All 12 sub-issues meet their acceptance criteria and focused tests.
- [ ] The pinned live run indexes 16 commits and PRs #10-#12, with honest gaps.
- [ ] Offline tests cover issue hierarchy, labels, chronology, and recovery without secrets.
- [ ] A real, explicitly enabled LangChain model run records grounded outputs and usage.
- [ ] Inspection examples explain changes, topics, work-item links, and their evidence.
- [ ] Replay/resume introduces no duplicate logical records and respects budgets.

## Inspection labels

Use `example:repo-history` for all epic work, `type:epic` for this parent,
`type:implementation` for children, and `area:*` for subsystem filtering.

GitLab, full-history indexing, a custom UI, distributed execution, and autonomous
GitHub mutation are outside this first release.
